en.hubeali:
And from him, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al A’la Bin Al Fuzayl, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When a man emerges upon a people to overlook upon them, or look at them from a crack of something of them, so they pelt him and it hits him, so he is either killed or blinds his eye, so there is no penalty upon them’.

And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A man peeked at Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> from a crack of his<sup>saww</sup> chamber, so Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> came over with an arrow in order to poke his eyes, so he<sup>saww</sup> found him to have gone away. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
Where is the filthy one? But, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, had he remained for me<sup>saww</sup>, I<sup>saww</sup> would have poked his eyes’.
